messages:
maria: Quick q — for long console forms do we do inline-only errors or inline + small right-rail summary after submit? Also final call on delete confirms: short typed token ("DELETE") or checkbox + undo?

alex: hybrid: inline on blur, show right-rail compact summary on failed submit. anchors to fields.

leah: hybrid + keyboard anchors. Summary should announce with aria-live.

sam: a11y points: role="alert" for submit failure, each summary item must be a real button that focuses the field and sets aria-describedby. Undo toast = role="status" and focusable.

jordan: required marker: stop relying on asterisk alone. Use explicit "Required" helper on key fields; faint asterisk elsewhere.

maria: delete tiers: low = modal, mid = checkbox + 10s undo, high = short typed token (type "DELETE"). Short token preferred vs full name.

ar ia-bot: preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/ux/validation-hybrid (feature flag enabled)

maria: Next steps: alex -> SideErrorSummary PR; leah -> a11y checklist; sam -> e2e aria-live test; jordan -> 5-person test Monday. Thanks!
